title: Coyote
wikitext:
[[image:coyote.png|thumb|]]

Pronounced 'kai-oh-tee'. A wild [[dog]] similar to a [[Wolf|wolf]]. In the real world, '''coyotes''' are smaller with big ears and more dog-like than wolves, but look just like wolves for the most part in World of Warcraft.  Coyotes are common in [[Westfall]].

== Traits ==
* Coyotes are [[hostile]].
* Coyotes often drop coyote [[meat]].
* Coyote corpses are [[skinnable]].
